questions: This Australian professional dancer joined a British ballroom competition in 2017 and picked up a BAFTA in 2025 after finally winning the contest the year before. Who is she?
Dianne Buswell (born 6 May 1989) is an Australian professional dancer who is best known for her appearances on the British television show Strictly Come Dancing.

This break in the skin or mucous membrane involves tissue breakdown severe enough to expose the dermis or fat beneath, and often becomes infected with pus — what condition is it?
Ulcer (dermatology) is a sore on the skin or a mucous membrane, accompanied by the disintegration of tissue.
